claim_one_line: The 'figure-eight knot group is non-congruence' headline is withdrawn: the 2-adic index jumps at level (8), so m004 is a congruence subgroup after all. [CORRECTED 2026-11-11 (the audit's finding E2; the error ledger's E23; B734's addenda of 2026-07-21 and 2026-09-16): the congruence level is (4). In SL(2, O₃/(4))/{±1}, the group that PSL(2, O₃) maps to, the image of the knot group already has the geometric index 12 (160 in 1920), and 6 at (2); 2 is inert, so no ideal lies between. "12 at (8)" is the reading in the quotient by every central unit of square one (order 960 at (4)), a filtration in which containment is sufficient for congruence and not necessary.]
